crossing_method: Two inspections, one at each side. The train holds roughly an hour at Mohan and again at Boten, and at both you take all your luggage off the train, clear the inspection hall on foot, and reboard the same train afterwards. You do not change trains, but you do not stay in your seat either.
note: A separate entry on the Lao register from the Boten road crossing. Through trains hold about 60 minutes here while passengers clear immigration.

common_name: Khamsavath Station (railway crossing to Nong Khai)
note: The Vientiane terminus of Thailand's railway line from Nong Khai, opened in 2023, about 7 km from the centre. Trains cross the Mekong on the 1st Friendship Bridge's rail track; Thai exit checks happen on the platform at Nong Khai and Lao entry formalities here. Served by the direct overnight sleeper to and from Bangkok Krung Thep Aphiwat (trains 133/134) and by shorter Nong Khai and Udon Thani trains. Visa on arrival and eVisa are both listed. Not to be confused with the Laos-China Railway's Vientiane station, a separate station about 14 to 15 km north-east of the centre that is not an immigration checkpoint.
